title: IncidentRecord
description: One public trace of an AI agent attacking or defending a system, in the incident registry (data/curated/incidents.yaml). Each is a real, sourced event; narrative claims are 'as reported' and MITRE tactics are the maintainer's mapping, not an attribution or finding of fault.

status.description: placeholder rows are for design review only and never shown as real

window.description: When it happened, in words ('intrusion over several days, disclosed 16 Jul 2026')

ai_role.description: What the AI agent did in this incident: ran the attack, defended, or was the thing exploited

category.description: red_team: researcher found and disclosed it; incident: happened in the wild

scale.description: Magnitude as reported ('lead data for N records'); mark 'unproven' where it is a claim

tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic ids the maintainer mapped from the public reports

tier.description: Evidence tier for this line (1 reproducible … 4 claim/allegation)

source.description: Source index (1-based) into sources, or a note

lessons.description: What a defender can take from it (the maintainer's reading)

related_agents.description: Catalog slugs this incident involves; cross-links to dossiers

cves.description: Official CVE ids the incident concerns; the CVE registry links to the incident and the incident page to the CVE

reviewer.description: null until a person checked the entry against its sources

specimen.description: true if an illustrative composite, not a single real event; shown labelled as such
